play/: Sid's personalities (SidVariable), drawn per board and shown as a partner would know them

Max, 21:14 UTC on 14 Nov: "Update Sid to randomize personalities", partners
correlated 0.5, SidVariable as the identifier other bots use, partners can
be asked for estimated styles, the variability and disclosure public.

- personas.py: each board North gets a persona, East-West a partnership
  (bridge_harness/persona.py at the bundle source); what the person may
  know (partner's knowledge view, opponents' disclosure), the actual styles
  after the board, the public rules.
- engine.py: bid/play take the seat's style per call (stateless); the Sids
  meet each other as SidVariable and treat it as keeping guaranteed
  contracts; Sid's own table plays the same N/E/W personas, South plain.
- tables/store/app/page: personas per board (stored, kept for a deal played
  again), a styles panel during and after the board and on the review page.
- Recipe: source moves to 109a21c (a42fe6c's engine plus the persona code).
- tests/test_personas.py (needs SIDPLAY_TEST_SOURCE with persona.py).
